_about: travel_time(mode='foot') results recorded from the kit's replay cache (OpenStreetMap OSRM data) in the MCP envelope, for every ordered pair of non-synthetic places in istanbul_research.json. Keys are 'from_place|to_place' with the listing names the planner sends. Failures (not_cached) are recorded as the tool returns them.
